Which institutions do you work with?

Partners include Charles Darwin University, Federation University Australia, Southern Cross University, University of the Sunshine Coast, University of Southern Queensland, Victoria University and others.
Can you help me change my course?
Yes. Omindra helps with changing your course or institute, and with visa extensions.
Do you have offices in India?
Yes, in Kurukshetra (Haryana) and Dehradun. Call +91 94160 03133.
aboutParas: Omindra Consultancy Services is an education and migration consultancy with its Australian office at 76-80 Station Street, Wentworthville, and offices in Kurukshetra and Dehradun in India.

Omindra offers expert solutions for overseas study and immigration, with a focus on Australia and New Zealand. Its mission is to be the most trusted education and migration consultant in India and abroad.
Omindra wants to be the biggest plus factor in students' lives when they go abroad for education or migration.
